description: The Vistogram from Omnivisto provides a very quick and easy interactive Power BI visual for schedule-based data sets. It overlaps the features of Gantt charts but provides a unique visual interface. It is drillable, scales up to 30K activities (and importantly, scales down to 10 or less). The Vistogram is highly configurable and can be tailored in terms of look, size and formatting to fit your existing dashboards and management information (MI) workflows. Key Benefits Drillable schedules that reflect your existing plans as many levels deep as you like. Our visual handles the hierarchy so you don't have to. Connect to source data (such as SmartSheet and SharePoint) directly and get scheduled (or real-time) updates. A resizable and style-able visual to match your brand. Low (or no) training requirement – click and drill. Suitable for a wide range of stakeholders. Combine schedules (including from different sources) using Power Query into a single view of everything. Detail on demand via Cross-filtering to other data sets with which there is a relationship. Fantastic tablet computing experience via the Power BI mobile application. Use Cases Project, programme and portfolio plans and schedules. Operations support – know what is happening when. Stakeholder engagement and communication.
